display_name: WCAG 2.1 AA & Pure Grex JS v1.0.0 Zero-Div Pattern Vault

entries.title: Dual-Theme Light & Dark Contrast Ratios (>= 4.50:1)
entries.summary: Verify foreground-to-background contrast meets at least 4.50:1 for normal text and 3.00:1 for large text across both Light and Dark themes.
rules: Normal body copy, labels, and button text must achieve a contrast ratio of >= 4.50:1 in both Light (#ffffff / #f8fafc) and Dark (#0f172a / #1e293b) surfaces.
Large headings (>= 18pt or 14pt bold) and UI focus boundaries must achieve >= 3.00:1.
Reuse active --grex-* tokens from GET /api/design-system.md rather than inventing ad-hoc color pairs.

entries.title: Zero Wrapper-Div & 20-Element Grex Taxonomy
entries.summary: Compose all layouts and studio panels strictly from the 20 Grex JS elements and semantic HTML5 landmarks with zero wrapper div elements.
rules: Use Section, Container, Grid, Stack, Card, Heading, Text, RichText, Link, Button, Image, Icon, Form, Input, Select, Tabs, Accordion, Modal, Nav, and ForEach exclusively.
Maintain sequential heading hierarchy (h1 -> h2 -> h3) without skipping heading levels.
Never nest layouts deeper than 24 levels and never call innerHTML, outerHTML, or eval().

entries.title: Keyboard Navigation, Dialog Escape & Focus Restoration
entries.summary: Guarantee full keyboard operability (Tab, Enter, Space, Escape) with focus restoration on modal dialogs and accessible labels on every control.
rules: Every Input, Select, and Button must carry an explicit accessible label or aria-label.
Every Image must include descriptive alt text unless explicitly marked isDecorative: true (alt: '').
Modal <dialog> confirmations must close on Escape and restore keyboard focus to the invoking trigger button.
